scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 final story / Extra Mission reward evidence
verification_policy: Separate story-clear rewards from Parallel Quest rewards and from DLC ownership. Record community acquisition evidence without promoting video descriptions into item-level canonical proof.

sources.scope: Final DLC feature set and release

sources.scope: Community-reported acquisition sequence for Power to Overcome, Super Time Patroller Suit, and Time Ring

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.reported_source: Final FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 story / Extra Mission completion
records.mechanics: Two-stage behavior is reported by secondary gameplay coverage, but the complete activation, duration, stat effects, and transformation rules remain unresolved in this evidence layer.

records.name: Super Time Patroller Uniform
records.reported_source: Final Chapter 4 content completion / return to Conton City
records.guaranteed_reward: reported_but_not established from item-level canonical data
records.known_delivery_issue: Community reports describe cases where the uniform did not appear after completion; Offline Lobby replay is reported as a workaround. This is recorded as an issue lead, not a universal current-version rule.

records.name: Time Ring of Memories
records.reported_source: Final Chapter 4 content completion / reward sequence
records.guaranteed_reward: reported_but_not established from item-level canonical data
records.known_delivery_issue: Community reports describe cases where the ring did not appear after completion; Offline Lobby replay is reported as a workaround. This is recorded as an issue lead, not a universal current-version rule.
records.costume_count_relationship: Do not count this ring as one of the six official Chapter 4 costumes/accessories without direct inventory evidence.

reconciled_facts.official_dlc_counts: Chapter 4 officially contains one Extra Mission, two Parallel Quests, four new moves including one Awoken Skill, six costumes/accessories, and four Super Souls.
reconciled_facts.pq_separation: PQ185 and PQ186 have their own documented reward pools; their costume and Super Soul entries are not automatically treated as final-story rewards.
reconciled_facts.story_reward_lead: Secondary Chapter 4 unlock guides consistently associate The Power to Overcome and the Super Time Patroller Suit / Time Ring reward sequence with completion of the final story content.
reconciled_facts.evidence_limit: The current evidence does not establish an exact internal mission ID, checkpoint, item ID, or canonical reward table for the three story-associated records.

important_nonclaims: Do not infer an exact story mission number from a video title or thumbnail.
Do not merge the Super Time Patroller Uniform with other similarly named Time Patroller outfits.
Do not merge Time Ring of Memories into the six official Chapter 4 costume/accessory count.
Do not treat DLC ownership as the same thing as the story-clear unlock requirement.
Do not assign Normal or Ultimate Finish terminology to story rewards.
Do not infer numerical drop rates or RNG percentages for story rewards.
Do not treat the reported Offline Lobby workaround as proof that online acquisition is universally broken.
research_targets: Identify the exact final Chapter 4 Extra Mission/story record and internal mission identifier.
Locate item-level evidence for The Power to Overcome acquisition.
Locate item-level evidence for the Super Time Patroller Uniform reward checkpoint.
Locate item-level evidence for Time Ring of Memories and determine whether it is granted at the same checkpoint.
Reconcile the story reward sequence with the six official costume/accessory records.
Check later patch notes for the reported reward-delivery issue and record the fixed version if documented.
